metadata.description: Database schema knowledge for coding agents: every table, view, procedure and function of a database, described in plain files an agent reads without a connection.

plugins.name: dbmap
plugins.description: Answers questions about a database without connecting to one: what a table holds, what a stored procedure does, which procedures write to a table, what a lookup code means. Works from an index of the schema kept as plain files - committed with a project, private to a machine, or published for a team - and can build, refresh and fetch that index, and say when it has gone out of date.
